---
- name: Create temporary values file
  ansible.builtin.tempfile:
    state: file
    suffix: "-cilium-values.yaml"
  register: cilium_values_tmp
- name: Template Cilium values file
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: cilium-values.yaml.j2
    dest: "{{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}"
    mode: "0600"
- name: Verify Helm is installed
  ansible.builtin.command: helm version --short
  register: cilium_helm_version
  changed_when: false
- name: Add Cilium Helm repository
  ansible.builtin.command: helm repo add cilium {{ cilium_chart_repo }}
  register: cilium_helm_repo_add
  changed_when: "'has been added' in cilium_helm_repo_add.stdout"
  failed_when: cilium_helm_repo_add.rc != 0 and 'already exists' not in cilium_helm_repo_add.stderr
- name: Update Helm repositories
  ansible.builtin.command: helm repo update
  register: cilium_helm_repo_update
  changed_when: "'Update Complete' in cilium_helm_repo_update.stdout"
- name: Install/upgrade Cilium with Helm
  ansible.builtin.command: >
    helm upgrade --install cilium cilium/{{ cilium_chart_name }}
    --version {{ cilium_version }}
    --namespace {{ cilium_namespace }}
    --values {{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}

  register: cilium_helm_install
  changed_when: >
    'STATUS: deployed' in cilium_helm_install.stdout or
    'STATUS: upgraded' in cilium_helm_install.stdout
- name: Wait for Cilium DaemonSet to be created
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl -n {{ cilium_namespace }} get ds cilium
  register: cilium_ds_check
  until: cilium_ds_check.rc == 0
  retries: "{{ cilium_wait_retries | default(60) }}"
  delay: "{{ cilium_wait_delay | default(5) }}"
  changed_when: false
- name: Wait for cilium pods
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    kubectl -n {{ cilium_namespace }} rollout status ds/cilium
    --timeout="{{ cilium_rollout_timeout }}s"
  register: cilium_rollout
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: cilium_rollout.rc != 0
- name: Remove temporary values file
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}"
    state: absent
  changed_when: false
- name: Wait for node to be Ready with Cilium
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready nodes --all --timeout=120s
  register: node_ready_wait
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Show node status if not ready
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl get nodes -o wide
  when: node_ready_wait.rc != 0
  changed_when: false

- name: Show node status
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl get nodes -o wide
  register: cilium_nodes_out
  changed_when: false

- name: Validate Tailscale IP is defined
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - tailscale_ip is defined
      - tailscale_ip | length > 0
      - tailscale_ip is match('^100\.')
    fail_msg: "ERROR: Invalid tailscale_ip ({{ tailscale_ip | default('undefined') }}). Must be 100.x.x.x"

- name: Ensure K3s config directory exists
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/rancher/k3s
    state: directory
    mode: "0755"

- name: Deploy K3s declarative configuration
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: config.yaml.j2
    dest: /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml
    mode: "0600"
  notify: Restart k3s

- name: Check for CNI directory existence

      - "87-podman-bridge.conflist"
  register: residual_cni_files
  when: cni_net_dir.stat.exists and cni_net_dir.stat.isdir

- name: Remove residual CNI configurations
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item.path }}"
    state: absent
  loop: "{{ residual_cni_files.files | default([]) }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.path }}"


- name: Install k3s server
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | \
      INSTALL_K3S_VERSION="{{ k3s_server_version }}" \
      sh -
  args:
    creates: /usr/local/bin/k3s
    executable: /bin/bash

- name: Flush handlers to ensure K3s restarts if config changed
  ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers
  when: ansible_facts['service_mgr'] == 'systemd'

- name: Wait for node-token
  ansible.builtin.wait_for:
    path: /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token
    timeout: "{{ k3s_server_node_token_timeout }}"
  when: not ansible_check_mode

- name: Read node token
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token
  register: k3s_server_token_raw
  when: not ansible_check_mode

- name: Set token fact on localhost
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    k3s_server_token: "{{ k3s_server_token_raw.content | b64decode | trim }}"
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
  when: not ansible_check_mode

- name: Ensure .kube directory exists for user {{ ansible_user }}
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "/home/{{ ansible_user }}/.kube"
    state: directory
    owner: "{{ ansible_user }}"
    group: "{{ ansible_user }}"
    mode: "0700"

- name: Read K3s kubeconfig
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml
  register: k3s_kubeconfig_raw

- name: Parse and modify kubeconfig for target user
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    k3s_kubeconfig_target: |
      {{ k3s_kubeconfig_raw.content | b64decode |
         regex_replace('https://127.0.0.1:6443', 'https://' + tailscale_ip + ':6443') }}

- name: Write kubeconfig for target user
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ k3s_kubeconfig_target }}"
    dest: "/home/{{ ansible_user }}/.kube/config"
    owner: "{{ ansible_user }}"
    group: "{{ ansible_user }}"
    mode: "0600"

- name: Wait for kube-apiserver (Standard Kubectl + Discovery)
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl api-resources
  register: k3s_server_readyz
  retries: "{{ k3s_server_readyz_retries }}"
  delay: "{{ k3s_server_readyz_delay }}"
  until: k3s_server_readyz.rc == 0
  changed_when: false
  when: not ansible_check_mode
  become: false

- name: Copy kubeconfig to local machine
  when:
    - k3s_server_copy_kubeconfig_local | default(true) | bool
    - not ansible_check_mode
  delegate_to: localhost
  become: false
  run_once: true
  block:
    - name: Ensure local .kube directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ k3s_server_local_kubeconfig_path | dirname }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0700"
    - name: Fetch kubeconfig from K3s server
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml
      register: k3s_server_kubeconfig_b64
      delegate_to: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
      become: true
    - name: Parse and modify kubeconfig
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        k3s_server_kubeconfig_local: |
          {{ k3s_server_kubeconfig_b64.content | b64decode |
             regex_replace('https://127.0.0.1:6443', 'https://' + tailscale_ip + ':6443') |
             regex_replace('name: default', 'name: k3s-' + inventory_hostname) |
             regex_replace('cluster: default', 'cluster: k3s-' + inventory_hostname) |
             regex_replace('user: default', 'user: k3s-' + inventory_hostname) |
             regex_replace('current-context: default', 'current-context: k3s-' + inventory_hostname)
          }}
    - name: Write kubeconfig to local path
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: "{{ k3s_server_kubeconfig_local }}"
        dest: "{{ k3s_server_local_kubeconfig_path }}"
        mode: "0600"
    - name: Show kubeconfig info
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "✅ Kubeconfig copied to: {{ k3s_server_local_kubeconfig_path }}"
          - "✅ Context name: k3s-{{ inventory_hostname }}"
          - "✅ Server URL: https://{{ tailscale_ip }}:6443"
          - ""
          - "Use kubectl with your existing installation:"
          - "  kubectl get nodes"
          - "  kubectl get pods -A"
